goal:
The `inventory` package in this project has five defects. `test_inventory.py` fails.

Read the code, work out what is wrong, and fix the package so every check passes.

The defects are spread across `inventory/models.py`, `inventory/pricing.py`, `inventory/stock.py` and `inventory/report.py` — more than one file is wrong, and one file has two separate problems. Each failing check names the behaviour that is wanted.

Do not change `test_inventory.py`: the checks describe the behaviour, and editing them is not a fix. Do not rewrite the modules wholesale — repair what is broken and leave the rest, including the existing style and the rule that money is held in whole pence, never floats.

Verify by running: python test_inventory.py. Report the exit code you actually saw.
